earth.en: Eighty million years ago, dinosaurs ruled the earth.
earth.cn: 八千万年前，地球是恐龙的天下。

play a part.en: Our workplace culture, social norms and individual behaviors all play a part.
play a part.cn: 我们工作场所的文化、社会规范和个人行为都发挥了作用。

play a part.en: Even though scientists play a part in transmitting information to journalists and ultimately the public, too often the blame for ineffective communication is placed on the side of the journalists.
play a part.cn: 尽管科学家在将信息传递给记者、最终把信息传递给公众方面发挥了一定作用，但人们往往还是将无效沟通归咎于记者。

peace.en: The dove is symbolic of peace.

sky.en: They woke to a clear blue sky.

astronaut.en: Hey, I want to meet an astronaut!
astronaut.cn: 嘿，我想认识一个宇航员！

apartment.cn: 这套公寓非常干净整洁。

apartment.en: I've got a pleasant little apartment.
apartment.cn: 我有一套舒适的小公寓。

rocket.cn: 火箭呼啸着朝天上飞去。

space station.en: Next year, a technology module will be docked on the space station.
space station.cn: 明年将有一个技术舱与航天站对接。

space station.en: Perhaps Joe will live on a space station in 10 years.
space station.cn: 也许10年后乔会住在空间站。

human.en: He retains a faith in human goodness.
It's not a thing. It's a human being!
human.cn: 这不是一件东西，这是一个人！

servant.en: He was a loyal, distinguished and very competent civil servant.
servant.cn: 他是一个忠诚、出色、很有能力的公务员。

servant.en: "I'm Mrs. Medlock's servant," she said stoutly.
servant.cn: “我是梅德洛克太太的仆人。”她坚定地说。

dangerous.en: In a world that had suddenly become alien and dangerous, he was her only security.
dangerous.cn: 在一个突然变得陌生而危险的世界里，他是她唯一的守护神。

dangerous.en: Robonaut2 can handle missions in outer space that are too dangerous for humans.
dangerous.cn: Robonaut2 可以在外太空执行对人类来说过于危险的任务。

already.en: The sun is already high in the sky.
already.cn: 太阳早已高挂在天上了。

already.en: The idea already existed in embryo in his earlier novels.
already.cn: 这个想法在他早期的小说中已初见端倪。

over and over again.en: I've told you over and over again not to do that.
over and over again.cn: 我一再跟你讲不要再那么做。

over and over again.en: Write down what you need to remember over and over again.
over and over again.cn: 一遍又一遍地写下你需要记住的东西。

believe.en: I believe in education for its own sake.
believe.cn: 我相信教育本身就是有价值的。

believe.en: I couldn't believe my eyes when she walked in.
believe.cn: 她走进来时我简直不相信自己的眼睛。

disagree.cn: 即便是朋友有时也有分歧。
“我不同意。”波利拒不妥协地说。

even.en: He even earned his opponents' grudging respect.
even.cn: 他甚至令对手也不得不尊重他。

even.en: Amy could sense his liveliness even from where she stood.
even.cn: 艾米甚至能从她所站的地方感受到他的勃勃生气。

hundreds of.en: She has coached hundreds of young singers.
hundreds of.cn: 她培养了许许多多的青年歌手。

hundreds of.en: There are literally hundreds of prizes to win.
hundreds of.cn: 真的有好几百份奖品可以领呀。

shape.en: She made a New Year's resolution to get in shape.
shape.cn: 她立下了新年决议，要改善体形。

shape.en: The shirt's cuffs won't sag and lose their shape after washing.
shape.cn: 这件衬衫的袖口洗后不会松垂变形。

fall down.en: The house looked as if it was about to fall down.
fall down.cn: 房子看起来好像就要倒塌似的。

inside.en: Train your muscles and bones outside, and train your gomoku inside.
inside.cn: 外练筋骨皮，内练五子棋。

inside.en: The tree trunk was hollow inside.

possible.en: We want the kids to have the best possible education.
possible.cn: 我们想让孩子们接受尽可能最好的教育。

possible.en: What I really want is to live healthily for as long as possible.
possible.cn: 我真正想要的是尽可能长久、健康地活着。

impossible.cn: 这在数学上是不可能的。

side.en: Heidi jumped and bounded gaily by their side.
side.cn: 海蒂高兴地在他们身边蹦蹦跳跳。

side.en: From Earth, we can only see one side of the moon.
side.cn: 从地球上，我们只能看到月球的一面。

probably.en: I can probably make the time to see them.
probably.cn: 我大概能腾出时间去看望他们。

probably.en: This is probably a bad idea, but what the hey!
probably.cn: 这大概是个馊主意，但管它呢！

during.en: Living standards improved rapidly during the post-war boom.
during.cn: 在战后那段繁荣昌盛的时期里，生活水平得到了迅速提高。

during.en: "This is what I've longed for during my entire career," Kendall exulted.
during.cn: “这是我整个职业生涯中一直期待的一刻，”肯德尔欢欣鼓舞地说。

shake.en: Be careful! Don't shake the ladder!
How much milk do we need to make a banana milk shake?
shake.cn: 做一份香蕉奶昔需要多少牛奶？

milk shake.en: She made an orange milk shake.

blender.en: Puree the cucumber in a blender. Mix in the yogurt.
blender.cn: 把黄瓜放入搅拌机打成泥，和酸奶混合在一起。

turn on.en: I want to turn on the television.
I wish I knew how to turn on the heating.
turn on.cn: 要是我知道如何打开暖气装置就好了。

peel.en: The paint is starting to peel off.
Will you peel the potatoes for me?
peel.cn: 你给我削土豆皮好不好？

pour.en: Letters of complaint continue to pour in.

yogurt.en: This yogurt comes in ten different flavours.
yogurt.cn: 这种酸奶有十种不同的味道。

yogurt.en: There's a yogurt left if you're still hungry.
yogurt.cn: 如果你还饿的话，还有一份酸奶。

honey.en: Have you seen my keys, honey?
honey.cn: 你见到我的钥匙了吗，宝贝？

honey.en: She licked the honey off the spoon.
honey.cn: 她舔光了调羹上的蜂蜜。

watermelon.cn: 昆虫很快会嗅到西瓜味。

pot.en: Usually, I like to eat hot pot.
Let me see, how about hot pot?

add.en: His book, I must add, is a masterpiece.
add.cn: 他的书，我必须补充一点，是一部杰作。

add.en: I always add some paprika for extra flavour.
add.cn: 我总是加一些辣椒粉来提味。

finally.cn: 他最终实现了自己的梦想。

finally.en: Dawn was breaking when they finally left.
finally.cn: 他们终于离开时正是破晓时分。

salt.en: Make sure you're getting real food without tons of added salt or sugar.
salt.cn: 确保你吃到的是真正的食物，没有添加大量的盐或糖。

salt.en: She took a pinch of salt with her right hand, rubbed a trickle into the pan, and beat her hands clean like a pair of cymbals.
salt.cn: 她用右手捏了一把盐，搓一撮盐放进锅内，然后把手拍干净，像敲钹一样。

sugar.en: She sprinkled sugar over the strawberries.
She sprinkled the strawberries with sugar.

cheese.en: Reduced-calorie cheese is a great substitute for cream cheese.
cheese.cn: 低卡路里干酪是奶油干酪的极好替代品。

cheese.en: Lunch was a feast of meat and vegetables, cheese, yoghurt and fruit, with unlimited wine.
cheese.cn: 午餐是一场盛宴，有肉、蔬菜、奶酪、酸奶和水果，以及不限量的葡萄酒。

popcorn.en: Linda lay face down on a living room couch, nibbling popcorn.
popcorn.cn: 琳达趴在客厅的一张沙发上，小口吃着爆米花。

popcorn.en: Nancy dipped into the bowl of popcorn that Hannah had made for them.
popcorn.cn: 南希把手伸进盛着汉娜给她们做的爆米花的碗里。

corn.en: Aid workers helped distribute corn, milk and other staples.
corn.cn: 救助人员协助分发谷物、牛奶及其他必需的食物。

corn.en: Horizon blue, corn yellow and pistachio green are just three of the vibrant colours in this range.
corn.cn: 天际蓝、玉米黄和淡草绿只是这一色域中的3种鲜亮色彩。

machine.en: This machine won't let you down.
machine.cn: 你尽管放心，这台机器不会出毛病。

machine.en: BTW, the machine is simply amazing.
machine.cn: 顺便提一句，这台机器简直太了不起了。

dig.en: In those days we often went to dig for wild vegetables.
dig.cn: 那时候我们常常出去挖野菜。

dig.en: To know the true answer, we need to dig deep into the question.
dig.cn: 为了获得真正的答案，我们需要深入探究问题。

hole.en: There is a superb 18-hole golf course 6 miles away.
hole.cn: 6英里外有个极好的18洞高尔夫球场。

hole.en: All they ever dream about is getting a hole in one.
hole.cn: 他们一直梦想着能一杆进洞。

butter.en: The edge is as blunt as an old butter knife.
butter.cn: 刃钝得跟一把老黄油刀一样。

butter.en: Meat and butter were prohibitively expensive.
butter.cn: 肉和奶油都贵得买不起。

turkey.en: We always eat turkey on Thanksgiving.
turkey.cn: 我们过感恩节时总是吃火鸡。

turkey.en: Pam was in the middle of basting the turkey.
turkey.cn: 潘姆正忙着往火鸡上浇汁。

lettuce.en: Why does it feel like even the lettuce is out to get us?
lettuce.cn: 为什么感觉甚至连莴苣都对我们不利呢？

lettuce.en: I have a tomato and a lettuce salad, and a tomato omelet.
lettuce.cn: 我要一份番茄莴苣沙拉，和一份番茄煎蛋卷。

piece.en: I cut a piece of birthday cake for them all.
piece.cn: 我给他们每个人都切了一块生日蛋糕。

piece.en: He whittled the piece of wood into a simple toy.
piece.cn: 他把那块木头削成了一个简易的玩具。

traditional.en: He arranged traditional folk songs for the piano.
traditional.cn: 他把传统民歌改编成钢琴曲。

traditional.en: It's traditional in America to eat turkey on Thanksgiving Day.
traditional.cn: 感恩节时吃火鸡是美国的传统。

traveler.en: What did they give to the traveler?

England.cn: 我很愿意再次为英格兰参赛。

celebrate.en: The club will celebrate its centenary next year.
celebrate.cn: 俱乐部明年要庆祝成立一百周年。
让我们来庆祝国庆节吧。

mix.en: It was a good mix of the old and the new.
If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.
mix.cn: 蓝色和黄色相混合就是绿色。

pepper.en: She shook some pepper onto her sandwich.
pepper.cn: 她在她的三明治上撒了些胡椒。

pepper.en: Brush the eggplant with oil, add salt and pepper, and bake till soft. Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a heavy pan.
pepper.cn: 给茄子刷好油，加盐和胡椒粉，烤到软。同时，加热厚底锅中剩余的油。

fill.en: More nurseries will be built to fill the need for high-quality child care.
fill.cn: 将建立更多的托儿所以满足高质量儿童保育的需要。

fill.en: Actually we do have a position in mind. Why don't you fill out our application?
fill.cn: 实际上我们确实在考虑设一个职位。你为什么不填一下我们的申请表呢？

oven.en: The oven takes a while to heat up.
oven.cn: 烤箱得过会儿才能热起来。

cover.en: Don't judge a book by its cover.
The cover of a book caught my eye.
cover.cn: 我被这本书的封面吸引了。

gravy.en: I'll have a chicken pie with gravy.
gravy.cn: 我要一份肉汁鸡肉馅饼。
你不能叫这东西肉汁吧？

serve.en: They serve good pub grub there.
serve.cn: 他们那儿供应上好的酒吧食物。

serve.en: He minced over to serve us.
serve.cn: 他迈着碎步过来招待我们。

temperature.en: The temperature reached a record low in London last night.
temperature.cn: 昨晚伦敦的气温降到了有记录以来的最低点。

temperature.en: Awakening of Insects signals a rise in temperature and increased rain fall.
temperature.cn: 惊蛰标志着气温上升，降雨量增加。

prepare.en: The ground staff do all they can to prepare the field.
prepare.cn: 场地保养人员全力准备赛场。

prepare.en: He has stepped up his training to prepare for the race.
prepare.cn: 他为准备那场比赛加强了训练。

prepare for.en: He has stepped up his training to prepare for the race.
prepare for.cn: 他为准备那场比赛加强了训练。

prepare for.en: I will prepare for my lessons before class.

exam.en: He passed the exam with ease.
exam.cn: 他轻而易举地通过了考试。

exam.en: She got full marks in the exam.

flu.en: I'm glad that you're over the flu.
flu.cn: 我很高兴你的流感好了。

flu.en: She was confined to bed with the flu.

available.en: Plants burgeon from every available space.
available.cn: 植物能从任何可获得的空间中迅速生长。

available.en: We must make good use of the available space.
available.cn: 我们必须充分利用现有空间。

another time.cn: 咱们其他时间再办这件事吧。

until.en: They practiced the dance until it was perfect.
until.cn: 他们反复练舞，直到尽善尽美为止。

until.en: He stood perfectly still until the danger had passed.
until.cn: 他一动不动地站在那里，直到危险解除。

hang.en: Don't hang up on me—we must talk!
hang.cn: 别挂断电话—我们一定得谈谈！

hang.en: Perhaps her ladyship would like to hang up her own clothes today!
hang.cn: 尊贵的夫人今天也许愿意动手自己把衣服挂起来吧！

hang out.en: We should hang out more often.
hang out.cn: 我们该常常一起出来玩。

hang out.en: We often hang out with our friends.
hang out.cn: 我们经常同朋友一起去闲逛。

catch.en: We can catch the early morning train.
catch.cn: 我们能赶上清晨的那班火车。

catch.en: I had to run like mad to catch the bus.
catch.cn: 为了赶上公共汽车，我不得不拼命跑。

invite.en: It was nice of them to invite us.
Let's invite her to come with us.

accept.en: Pride would not allow him to accept the money.
accept.cn: 自尊心不容他接受这笔钱。

accept.en: She learned to accept criticism without rancour.
accept.cn: 她学会了坦然接受批评而不怀恨在心。

refuse.en: I refuse to compromise my principles.
refuse.cn: 我拒绝在原则问题上妥协。

refuse.en: The offer was too enticing to refuse.
refuse.cn: 这提议太有诱惑力，使人难以拒绝。

the day before yesterday.en: To think I was lying on a beach only the day before yesterday.
the day before yesterday.cn: 想想吧，就在前天，我还躺在海滩上呢。

the day before yesterday.en: She reached Paris the day before yesterday.

the day after tomorrow.en: I'll see you the day after tomorrow.

weekday.en: There are several free hours every weekday.
weekday.cn: 每个工作日都有几个小时的空闲时间。

weekday.en: You should avoid riding during weekday rush periods.
weekday.cn: 你应该避免在工作日的高峰时段骑车。

look after.en: It makes sense to look after yourself.
look after.cn: 照顾好你自己是明智的。

look after.en: Your baby depends on you to look after yourself properly while you are pregnant.
look after.cn: 你的宝宝靠你怀孕时好好照顾你自己。

invitation.cn: 我礼貌地回绝了他们的邀请。

invitation.en: I was gratified by their invitation.
invitation.cn: 收到他们的邀请，我感到很高兴。

turn down.en: Why would you turn down a fruit bowl?
Could you please turn down the CD player a little?
turn down.cn: 你能把唱片播放机的声音关小一点吗？

reply.cn: 回答是个干脆利落的“不”字。

forward.en: We've put the wedding forward by one week.
forward.cn: 我们已把婚礼提前了一周。

forward.en: He cracked his whip and the horse leapt forward.
forward.cn: 他甩了个响鞭，马儿就奋蹄向前奔去。

delete.en: I selected a file and pressed the delete key.
delete.cn: 我选定了一份文件，然后按下了删除键。

delete.en: You should delete the superfluous expressions.
delete.cn: 你应该删掉多余的表达。

print.en: I got a kick out of seeing my name in print.
print.cn: 看到我的名字被印成铅字，我感到非常兴奋。

print.en: It was the first time he had seen his name in print.
print.cn: 那是他第一次见到自己的名字被刊印出来。

goodbye.en: "Drive safely," he said and waved goodbye.

glad.en: He was glad to be home again.

preparation.en: The key to success is preparation.
Careful preparation for the exam is essential.
preparation.cn: 认真准备考试十分必要。

glue.en: I made a model out of paper and glue.
glue.cn: 我用纸和胶水做了一个模型。

without.en: She met his gaze without flinching.
without.cn: 她毫不畏缩地与他对视。

without.en: His reputation is without a blemish.
without.cn: 他的名誉可说是白璧无瑕。

surprised.en: He has surprised us before with his inventiveness.
surprised.cn: 他以前曾以创造才能令我们吃惊。

surprised.en: He surprised me with his intimate knowledge of Kierkegaard and Schopenhauer.
surprised.cn: 他对克尔恺郭尔和叔本华的深刻了解令我感到惊奇。

look forward to.en: I look forward to hearing from you.
I now look forward to going back to work as soon as possible.
look forward to.cn: 我现在盼望尽快回到工作中。

hear from.en: It was great to hear from you.
I hope to hear from you.

housewarming.en: It is traditional to bring a gift to a housewarming party.
housewarming.cn: 按照传统，人们应该带礼物参加乔迁派对。

housewarming.en: The best housewarming parties encourage old friends to get together.
housewarming.cn: 最好的乔迁派对让老朋友们聚在一起。

opening.en: This gadget's great for opening jars.
opening.cn: 这小玩意儿开广口瓶挺好。

opening.en: There's a new Thai restaurant opening up in town.
opening.cn: 城里有一家新的泰国餐馆开张了。

concert.cn: 这场音乐会是一次十足的享受。

concert.en: Their concert there was a sell-out.
concert.cn: 他们在那儿的音乐会座无虚席。

headmaster.en: He was headmaster of a public school in the West of England.
headmaster.cn: 他曾是英格兰西部一所公学的校长。

event.en: The event was an undoubted success.
event.cn: 这次活动是一个无可置疑的成功。

event.en: The event was voted a great success.
event.cn: 大家认为这项活动很成功。

guest.en: The guest list reads like a roll-call of the nation's heroes.
guest.cn: 客人名单念起来就像是在列数民族英雄。

guest.en: Mrs. Hardie hurried to make up for her tactlessness by asking her guest about his holiday.
guest.cn: 哈迪太太赶紧问她的客人假期过得如何，以弥补此前不得体的言行。

calendar.en: It is one of the hottest tickets on Washington's social calendar.
calendar.cn: 这是华盛顿社交日程表上最热门的入场券之一。

calendar.en: I use the old calendar I saved to do crafts with my kids.
calendar.cn: 我用自己保留下的旧日历和孩子一起做手工。

daytime.en: The park is open during (the) daytime.
Some animals are inactive during the daytime.

meeting.en: The meeting ended on an upbeat note.
meeting.cn: 会议在乐观的气氛中结束。

video.en: Let's play a video game together.
video.cn: 我们一起玩视频游戏吧。

video.en: How about a video blog, or a podcast?
video.cn: 不如尝试一下视频博客，或者播客？

potato chips.cn: 你要不要来点我的洋芋片？

potato chips.cn: 我们需要把薯片放到碟子里。

upset.en: Don't be upset—I'm sure she meant it as a compliment.
upset.cn: 别烦恼—我肯定她的原意是要称赞你的。

upset.en: Don't upset yourself about it—let's just forget it ever happened.
upset.cn: 你别为这事烦恼了—咱们就只当它没发生过。

advice.cn: 他提出了一些有益的建议。

agent.en: My agent has pitched the idea to my editor in New York.
agent.cn: 我的代理人已向我在纽约的编辑力荐这个想法。

agent.en: When the estate agent showed us this house, we knew we wanted it right away.
agent.cn: 当房地产经纪人带我们看这所房子时，我们就知道要立刻买下它。

expert.cn: 他赢得了税法专家的美名。

expert.en: Harvey cured the pain with his own expert hands.
expert.cn: 哈维用他那行家之手治愈了那病痛。

teenager.cn: 我十几岁的时候腼腆得很。

teenager.en: He was acting like a lovelorn teenager.
teenager.cn: 他表现的像一个患有相思病的少年。

normal.en: It's perfectly normal to feel like this.
normal.cn: 有这样的感觉是完全正常的。

normal.en: It's a normal part of the learning process.

WildAid.en: On September 22nd in Shanghai WildAid, a charity, launched a campaign to persuade Chinese people to give up eating the delicacy.
WildAid.cn: 9月22日，一家慈善机构——野生救援协会在上海发起了一场旨在劝说国人放弃食用鱼翅汤的活动。

WWF.en: We sincerely hope that WWF can play a role in protecting this endangered species.
WWF.cn: 我们真诚地希望世界自然基金会能在保护这个濒危的野生物种中发挥作用。

WWF.en: As the most famous animal of China, the giant panda appears in the logo of the World Wildlife Fund for Nature (WWF).
WWF.cn: 作为中国最著名的动物，大熊猫出现在世界自然基金会（WWF）的标志上。

Mark.en: Mark Spitz was a great athlete.
Mark.cn: 马克·斯皮茨是一名伟大的运动员。

Mark.en: Mark had a job lined up when he left college.
Mark.cn: 马克大学毕业时，工作已经安排好了。

Jason.en: Jason had helped him out with a series of loans, until he could get back on an even keel.
Jason.cn: 詹森给他提供了一连串贷款帮他摆脱困境，直到他能够重新稳定下来。

Jason.en: Corporal Jason Dunham covered the grenade with a helmet and the helmet with his body.
Jason.cn: 下士詹森·杜汉姆用头盔盖住了手榴弹，并用自己的身体盖住了头盔。

Ken.en: What are you going to do this weekend, Ken?
Ken.cn: 肯恩，这个周末你打算做什么？

Ken.en: One day, Ann and Ken took Mocky to the town center.
Ken.cn: 一天，安和肯带摩奇来到市中心。

Hayes.en: You have probably never heard of Amy Hayes, but she is a most unusual woman.
Hayes.cn: 你可能从未听说过艾米·海耶斯，但她是一个非常不同寻常的女人。

Hayes.en: "We didn't do any global consideration," says Patricia Hayes, the board's chair.
Hayes.cn: 董事会主席帕特里夏·海耶斯说：“我们没有做任何全球性的考虑。”

Jessica.cn: 杰西卡若有所思地喝了一小口饮料。

Jessica.en: Jessica caught a secret smile flitting between the two of them.
Jessica.cn: 杰西卡看见他们俩诡秘地相视一笑。

Survey.en: We look forward to the next survey.
Survey.cn: 我们期待下一次类似的调研。

Survey.en: We would welcome your views about the survey.
Survey.cn: 我们欢迎你们对这项调查提出意见。

standard.en: Her work has been of a consistently high standard.
standard.cn: 她的工作一直是高水准的。

standard.en: People in this country enjoy a high standard of living.
standard.cn: 这个国家的人民享有很高的生活水平。

row.en: This is her third win in a row.
row.cn: 这是她连续获得的第三次胜利。

row.en: We went for a row on the lake.

in a row.en: This is her third win in a row.
in a row.cn: 这是她连续获得的第三次胜利。

in a row.en: Inflation has fallen for the third month in a row.
in a row.cn: 通货膨胀率连续第三个月在下降。

keyboard.en: Tanya's hands rippled over the keyboard.
keyboard.cn: 坦尼娅的双手在键盘上起伏摆动。

keyboard.en: He studied the keyboard carefully, one finger poised.
keyboard.cn: 他仔细审视着键盘，一根手指摆好了姿势。

instruction.en: Each candidate is given instruction in safety.
instruction.cn: 每位候选人都被给予了安全指导。

instruction.en: This technique brings life to instruction and eases assimilation of knowledge.
instruction.cn: 这种技术给教学带来活力，并使知识的吸收更加容易。

double.en: It has the double advantage of being both easy and cheap.
double.cn: 它具有既方便又便宜的双重优点。

overcome.en: Failures can help us learn and overcome our fears.
overcome.cn: 失败可以帮助我们学习并克服恐惧。

make a mess.en: Our mothers sat us down to read and paint, when all we really wanted to do was to make a mess.
make a mess.cn: 我们的妈妈们让我们坐下读书、画画，而我们真正想要做的却是胡闹一阵。

make a mess.en: If you make a mess, you clean it up yourself.
make a mess.cn: 如果你把事情弄得一团糟，你就得自己收拾残局。

graduate.en: After all his hard work, he now needs only two credit hours to graduate.
graduate.cn: 通过努力学习，他现在只需再修两个学分就可以毕业了。

graduate.en: I will graduate from Peking University this July.
graduate.cn: 我今年七月将从北京大学毕业。

senior.en: She'll be racing for the senior team next year.
senior.cn: 明年她将参加高级组别的比赛。

senior.en: In her current role she broke through the glass ceiling as the first woman to reach senior management level in the company.
senior.cn: 在她目前的职位上，她突破了那道升迁的无形障碍，成为公司里第一位升至高级管理层的女性。

senior high (school).en: In 1966, I was at the senior high school which offered Latin and French as foreign languages.
senior high (school).cn: 1966年，我读高中，学校的外语课是拉丁文和法文。

senior high (school).en: I am a senior high school student learning fine arts.
senior high (school).cn: 我是一名学美术的高三学生。

text.en: Burton's text is concise and informative.
text.cn: 伯顿的文章文字简洁、内容丰富。

text.en: Future lawyers could study this text with profit.
text.cn: 未来的律师研读这一文本也许会有裨益。

level.en: I want to get to the next level!
Make sure the camera is level before you take the picture.
level.cn: 拍照前要保证相机处于水平位置。

manager.en: He resigned as manager after eight years.
manager.cn: 八年后，他辞去了经理的职务。

manager.en: The new publicity manager is really on the ball.
manager.cn: 新任宣传部经理的确精明干练。

believe in.en: We believe in the power of prayer.
I believe in education for its own sake.
believe in.cn: 我相信教育本身就是有价值的。

gentleman.en: He behaved like a true gentleman.
gentleman.cn: 他的行为像个真正的绅士。

graduation.en: My whole family came to my graduation.
graduation.cn: 我的家人都来参加了我的毕业典礼。

graduation.en: "You have to come to Todd's graduation party."—"I'd be delighted."
graduation.cn: “你一定要来参加托德的毕业派对。”——“非常乐意。”

ceremony.en: The ceremony went off without a hitch.
10 000 balloons were released at the ceremony.
ceremony.cn: 典礼上放飞了一万个气球。

congratulate.en: I congratulate all of you on this achievement.
congratulate.cn: 我祝贺你们的这一成就。

task.en: The task requires extraordinary patience and endurance.
task.cn: 这项工作需要非凡的耐心和毅力。

task.en: The task won't feel so overwhelming if you break it down into small, easy-to-accomplish steps.
task.cn: 如果你把这个任务分解成一个个容易完成的小步骤，就不会觉得那么难以应对。

ahead.en: She was always well ahead of the rest of the class.
ahead.cn: 她总是遥遥领先班上的同学。

ahead.en: There were two children ahead, walking side by side.
ahead.cn: 前面有两个孩子肩并肩走着。

responsible.en: We are all entirely responsible for our actions, and for our reactions.
responsible.cn: 我们都对自己的行为、自己的反应完全负责。

responsible.en: Our duty is to hold ourselves responsible to the people.
responsible.cn: 我们的责任，是向人民负责。

be responsible for.en: Who should be responsible for this?
I will be responsible for dealing with this mess.
be responsible for.cn: 我会负责处理这个烂摊子。

separate.en: Far from being separate, the mind and body form an indivisible whole.
separate.cn: 心智与身体绝不是分离的,它们形成了一个不可分割的整体。

separate.en: He rescued the company and later spun off its textile division into a separate entity.
separate.cn: 他挽救了该公司，后来又把它的纺织部脱离出来组建成一个独立实体。

wing.en: The new wing was built onto the hospital last year.
wing.cn: 医院的新翼楼是去年增建的。

wing.en: It is a very pretty butterfly, with a 2 inch wing span.
wing.cn: 它是一只非常漂亮的蝴蝶，翅膀张开有2英寸宽。

Brian.en: Brian was ensconced behind the bar.
Brian remembers learning to fish in the Colorado River.
Brian.cn: 布莱恩记得在科罗拉多河学过钓鱼。

Luke.en: How can you drink so much beer, Luke?
Luke.cn: 卢克，你怎么可以喝这么多啤酒？

Luke.en: Luke had an amazingly retentive memory.

Griffin.en: Mr. Griffin made a jerky gesture.
Griffin.cn: 格里芬先生打了个急促而不连贯的手势。

Griffin.en: Mr. Griffin gave a regretful smile.
Griffin.cn: 格里芬先生遗憾地笑了笑。

Trent.en: Trent Dimas won gold in the final men's gymnastic event.
Trent.cn: 特伦特·迪马斯在男子体操决赛中赢得了金牌。

Trent.en: Nottingham Trent University and the Chinese Academy of Sciences have been trying to find a way to prevent deadly outdoor air pollution from penetrating indoors.
Trent.cn: 诺丁汉特伦特大学和中国科学院一直在努力寻找一种方法来防止致命的室外空气污染渗透到室内。
